title: Escalation Routing Rule R-013: Patient complaint about staff
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-013 -- Patient complaint about staff
TRIGGER TYPE: Grievance
CONDITION: Attender registers formal service complaint
ROUTE TO: Quality and Patient Safety (Extension 1032)
QUEUE: QUEUE_QUALITY
PRIORITY: HIGH
SLA: 4.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Patient satisfaction and NABH compliance. Log in Quality Portal, dispatch to Quality Manager ext. 1032.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Attender complained of delay in breakfast
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Complaint regarding rude behavior at counter
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-013 (Patient complaint about staff) v1.0
